answer: Use a canyon-gate ferrous assay: a newcomer locks a $130 bond and registers one hardware key, then earns passage by completing 15 verified jobs across three canyon checkpoints in 45 days. Each job carries a ferrous assay seal proving the same key did the work, and two random established peers re-run five jobs. Fail two audits and the bond burns, with a 60-day ban. The karst route matters because shortcuts collapse: faking 1,000 identities needs $130,000 in bonds plus 15,000 real jobs, about 3,750 hours. Like a toll bridge over a real canyon, only travellers who actually cross get through.
